title: SEBI Cuts the Unhedged Currency Derivative Position Limit to US$5 Million
court: Securities and Exchange Board of India
case_name: SEBI circular revising threshold limits for unhedged foreign exchange exposure under exchange-traded currency derivatives
citation: SEBI circular dated 5 November 2026, modifying Clause 5.3.3 of the SEBI Master Circular for Stock Exchanges and Clearing Corporations dated 30 December 2024
card_summary: SEBI's 5 November 2026 circular cuts the unhedged limit on exchange-traded rupee currency derivatives from US$100 million to US$5 million, combined across all INR pairs and exchanges. The cap covers domestic clients and foreign portfolio investors alike. An FPI wanting a larger long position must show matching exposure in Indian debt or equity; a domestic client may exceed it only on conditions RBI has set.
card_tip: FPIs and treasuries hedging INR exposure through exchange-traded currency derivatives should check their combined open position now; anything over US$5 million without matching Indian debt or equity exposure must be cut.
verification_notes: AUDIENCE: foreign company (FPIs and other foreign currency hedgers). TARGET QUERY: SEBI new limit on unhedged currency derivative positions for FPIs. DEMAND EVIDENCE: none seen (no search-volume or trending data was opened; the circular was carried by several financial-news and compliance sites within days, suggesting market interest, but that is not search-volume evidence). Cross-verified against the SEBI circular itself (sebi.gov.in PDF, dated 5 November 2026) and against Moneylife, Outlook Money, Outlook Business, New Kerala and CorpLawUpdates, which agree on the date, the new US$5 million cap, that it replaces a US$100 million limit, that it applies combined across INR currency pairs and exchanges, that FPIs need underlying debt/equity exposure to exceed it, and that domestic clients may exceed it only per RBI's Master Direction on Risk Management and Inter-Bank Dealings and RBI's related 10 October 2026 circular. The circular amends Clause 5.3.3 of SEBI's Master Circular for Stock Exchanges and Clearing Corporations dated 30 December 2024. One secondary source cited an unverified circular reference number (HO/(561)2026-MRD-POD2/I/25177/2026); that number is omitted here as not independently confirmed from the primary PDF text seen.
